mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.content, c.like_count, c.create_time FROM comment AS c WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time ASC
